scripts.start:processes: concurrently -k -n api,web -c blue,green "npm run api:internal" "npm run web:internal"
scripts.api:internal: cd backend && (test -d node_modules || npm install --no-audit --no-fund) && npm start
scripts.web:internal: cd frontend && (test -d node_modules || npm install --no-audit --no-fund) && npm run dev
scripts.build: cd frontend && (test -d node_modules || npm install --no-audit --no-fund) && npx ng build
scripts.db:up: node scripts/strip-db-sh.cjs && node scripts/run-with-stack.cjs bash scripts/db.sh up
scripts.db:down: node scripts/strip-db-sh.cjs && node scripts/run-with-stack.cjs bash scripts/db.sh down
scripts.db:reset: node scripts/strip-db-sh.cjs && node scripts/run-with-stack.cjs bash scripts/db.sh reset
scripts.db:sync-remote: node scripts/strip-db-sh.cjs && node scripts/run-with-stack.cjs bash scripts/sync-remote-to-docker.sh
scripts.db:seed: node scripts/strip-db-sh.cjs && node scripts/run-with-stack.cjs bash scripts/seed-local-docker.sh
